name: Cable Stability Ball Single-Arm Fly
steps: Rest your head and upper back on a stability ball beside a low pulley with your feet apart and its handle held above your chest.
Open your working arm toward the pulley with your elbow slightly bent.
Draw your hand back above your chest on the same wide arc.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your sternum pointing upward throughout the fly.
Keep your hips lifted and stop lowering your arm before your torso rolls toward the pulley.
